questions.question: 写一个把流式 TTS 代理到浏览器的服务，并能在用户离开页面时干净利落地取消。
questions.questionEn: Write a service that proxies streaming TTS to a browser and cancels cleanly when the user navigates away.

questions.topicName: 推理、服务与 GPU 性能
questions.question: 为实时 TTS 提供服务与为文本 LLM 提供服务是不同的容量问题。为什么？你会如何做容量规划？
questions.questionEn: Serving real-time TTS is a different capacity problem from serving a text LLM. Why, and how do you plan capacity?

questions.topicName: 安全、安保与负责任 AI
questions.question: 为语音克隆设计安全技术栈：用户同意、水印与滥用响应。
questions.questionEn: Design the safety stack for voice cloning: consent, watermarking and abuse response.

questions.topicName: 多模态、语音与声音 AI
questions.question: 为实时语音 agent 做端到端延迟预算。为什么 time-to-first-audio 与 LLM 的 time-to-first-token 是不同的难题？
questions.questionEn: Budget the end-to-end latency for a real-time voice agent. Why is time-to-first-audio a different problem from an LLM's time-to-first-token?

sources.title: 设计实时语音 AI Agent

questions.topicName: 多模态、语音与声音 AI
questions.question: 在生产环境里，TTS 质量真正崩掉的地方就是文本规范化。请详细讲讲你会怎么做。
questions.questionEn: Text normalisation is where TTS quality actually dies in production. Walk me through it.

questions.topicName: 多模态、语音与声音 AI
questions.question: 设计配音流水线：一段英语视频变成西班牙语，说话人不变，时间轴不变。
questions.questionEn: Design the dubbing pipeline: an English video becomes Spanish, same speakers, same timing.

questions.question: 一个医院集团靠三名员工轮班、用电话人工安排和确认门诊预约。请设计我们会为他们构建的系统。
questions.questionEn: A hospital group schedules and confirms outpatient appointments by phone, manually, with three staff on a rota. Design what we would build for them.

questions.question: 一个联络中心想用语音 agent 替换它的 IVR。请主导这次客户交付。
questions.questionEn: A contact centre wants to replace its IVR with voice agents. Run the engagement.
